_meta.filter: litellm_provider in {bedrock, bedrock_converse, bedrock_mantle}; input_cost_per_token and output_cost_per_token both non-null; sample_spec excluded. Key prefix stripped per provider (bedrock/ for bedrock|bedrock_converse, bedrock_mantle/ for bedrock_mantle); keys containing / after strip excluded (non-routeable region/routing prefixes). bedrock_mantle keys are then namespaced under mantle/ — NOT merged into the flat namespace: several IDs exist under both bedrock_converse and bedrock_mantle, some at different rates (e.g. openai.gpt-6-sol: $2/$10 vs $2.20/$11 per 1M), so a flat merge would let dict order silently re-price an existing Converse model. Result = token-priced, routeable model IDs incl. token-priced embeddings (input>0, output 0). NOTE: entries with BOTH token costs 0 (e.g. rerank) carry no billing value and are dropped by gen_pricing.py (Pass-1 guard). output_cost_per_reasoning_token is retained when present so gen_pricing.py can warn that our rates would underbill. Service-tier keys (*_flex, *_priority) retained so gen_pricing.py can price the Flex and Priority tiers.
